text:
Maya K: Heads-up — saw p99 tail spikes on the embeddings-rerank non-chat endpoint during the 21:00 UTC traffic ramp. Peaked ~340ms extra per request for heavy batches.
Samir: Do you have profiles/logs? kernel or batching side?
Maya K: Attached quick flame from profiler (samples over 2m):
```text
p50 12ms
p95 42ms
p99 218ms -> 560ms during spike
kernel: attn-fused-16b-int8
KV cache evicts spiking: 40% of requests
``` 
Liam: KV thrash + big variable token counts = bad combo. Non-chat rerank requests vary 16->512 tokens, when a 512 hits same batch as 16 we lose packing efficiency.
Natalie: Suggest token_budget_per_batch target(=2048) + max_batch_tokens=4096 + early_fill_threshold=0.7
Maya K: Also saw a kernel selection regression after the 2026-03 kernel bump — int8 path slower on short seq due to extra dequant step. Maybe prefer fp16-smallseq kernel for seq<=64.
Samir: Agree. We should add kernel affinity rule: if seq_len <= 64 and total_batch_tokens <= 1024 prefer fp16-smallseq kernel. Try config:
```yaml
batch_policy:
  max_wait_ms: 6
  prefill_ms: 10
  token_budget_target: 2048
  early_fill_pct: 0.7
kernel_affinity:
  - cond: seq_len <= 64 and batch_tokens <= 1024
    kernel: fp16_smallseq
  - else: attn_fused_16b_int8
```
Maya K: Also propose burst_smoothing on queue: allow up to 2x burst for 100ms then throttle back. That will prevent immediate KV eviction storms.
Natalie: Can we experiment with lower prefill (6-10ms) + burst_smoothing? That helps form better homogeneous batches.
infra-bot: deploy-canary to staging at 10% with config rerank-prefill-windowed-smoothing.yml
qa-bot: test script to reproduce load:
```bash
wrk -t8 -c200 -d60 -s scripts/rerank-bulk.lua --latency --header 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV'
```
Liam: I'll run the script and capture kv-cache metrics + kernel selection counters.
Samir: If we see p99 drop, we should promote and also file a perf regression ticket for the int8 kernel.
Maya K: I'll own the dashboard watch and do a canary run tonight. tagging @Liam @Natalie :eyes: 
Natalie: cool — will prepare rollout plan and SLA rollback steps.
Maya K: TL;DR: try token_budget 2k, prefill 10ms, kernel affinity smallseq->fp16, burst_smoothing 100ms window. Run canary and monitor kv_evictions and p99.
Samir: SGTM :thumbsup: 
infra-bot: canary rolled back to 0% (automated) — triggers: kv_evictions > 30% or p99 increase > 10%
Maya K: got it, will iterate on kernel config in follow-up if rollback happens.
